chilimix_uart.note: 8-bit registers on a 32-bit bus: PRDATA bits 31:8 and PSLVERR (every offset is decoded) are constant; 91.9 % locally with Verilator 5.020, which counts fewer points than CI's.

chilimix_debug_dm.note: the FSM default branch is unreachable and dmi_rsp_op is constant 0 (errors go to cmderr); constant fields (dmstatus, the unused CMD words, cmd_q's cmdtype / aarsize bits) count as untoggled

chilimix_debug.note: Wiring top: its testbench checks every path once (JTAG, DMI, SBA at three sizes, the DM memory, debug_req / ndmreset), so its 32-bit buses carry few values; the units' testbenches toggle them fully.

chilimix_spi_regs.note: Generated register block: regbank bus bits with no field are constant and count as untoggled (CI's Verilator counts more of them than 5.020); its testbench checks every field port.

chilimix_spi_phy.note: The FSM default branch is unreachable; the upper bits of the 12-bit divisor and its tick counter stay 0 (a slow sck would need thousands of clocks per edge).

chilimix_spi_xip.note: The case default branches of the fill state machine are unreachable.

chilimix_spi.note: sckdiv and the delay registers stay small to bound the run time, and PSLVERR never rises (the map is fully decoded); chilimix_spi_phy_tb and chilimix_spi_xip_tb toggle the wide values.

chilimix_i2c_regs.note: Generated register block: regbank bus bits with no field are constant and count as untoggled (CI's Verilator counts more of them than 5.020), and every i2c register is 8 bits of the 32; its testbench checks every field port.

chilimix_i2c_bit.note: The case default of the line levels is unreachable (every state has its branch).

chilimix_i2c.note: The registers are 8 bits wide, so PRDATA bits 31:8 stay 0, and PSLVERR never rises; the byte state machine's case default is unreachable.

chilimix_dma_ch.note: zero32 (the 32 high address bits that read 0) is constant and PSLVERR never rises in the testbench's legal accesses.

chilimix_dma_regs.note: Generated register block: regbank bus bits with no field are constant and count as untoggled (CI's Verilator counts more of them than 5.020); its testbench checks every field port.

chilimix_dma.note: Lines: the BASE / MASK constant functions run at elaboration and the engine's case default is unreachable. Toggle: HBURST / HMASTLOCK are constant, the channels' PSLVERR never rises, and transfers stay at 64 bytes or less so the high byte-count bits stay 0 (chilimix_dma_ch_tb toggles them).
